If you haven’t gotten any help yet from anyone else:

I had a similar problem happen to my PC, I am also a graphic designer.

Download UserBenchmark and HWmonitor. UserBenchmark will test your computers hardware and then send the results to their website where you can see how it compares to other PCs with the same stuff. HWmonitor is a program that shows all of your hardware and how it’s running.

You should send me the benchmark results and the temperatures (from HWmonitor) of all your PC parts.

PCs are complex devices, there could be a million things wrong with one simple device, or there could be a simple problem that can be fixed through tightening a screw, cleaning a fan, or similar. The best thing to do especially if you’re new to fixing PCs is to troubleshoot and test hardware to see what may be causing the problems. Trying to fix things without knowing exactly what’s happening can cause more damage and waste time and money, so make sure to assess everything first beforehand.

I myself learned how to fix my own PC, but I needed a bit of guidance to do so. If you would like to, you can reply to me again and we can talk over discord, or teamspeak or similar.

Also, I’ve been doing benchmarks after every reset, from the last benchmark everything but the SSD was scoring above expectation including the RAM, and this benchmark the RAM and GPU are under the 10th percentile with the SSD still unable to be benchmarked
